_note: Rule numbers and short paraphrases from the Formula SAE Rules 2027, Version 1.0 (1 September 2026, SAE International). Paraphrased, not quoted: read the rulebook for the exact wording. Limits are as published in that version; check later versions and the Q&A.
name: Formula SAE 2027 (IC)

checks.summary: Wheelbase at least 1525 mm
The smaller track is at least 75 % of the larger
Doesn't roll at a 60° tilt (1.7 g) with the tallest driver and full fluids
At least 50 mm of usable wheel travel, front, driver seated
At least 50 mm of usable wheel travel, rear, driver seated
Wheels at least 203.2 mm (8 in) in diameter, front
Wheels at least 203.2 mm (8 in) in diameter, rear
Suspension and steering bolts are Critical Fasteners: SAE Grade 5, metric 8.8, AN/MS or better
Rod ends and spherical bearings in double shear, or captured by a bolt head or washer larger than the bearing housing's bore
Steering stops keep the linkage from locking up (the four-bar inverting): the steering solves out to the full rack travel
Nothing in the keep-out zone 75 mm ahead of and behind each tire, between the tire's inner and outer planes, wheels straight
Steering stops keep the tires off the suspension, bodywork and chassis: the rim clears the links at full lock and bump
Nothing but the tires touches the ground: the car's lowest points (car file and frame model) at every body position the dampers allow, with pitch, roll and the tires squashed
Driver template's hip circle at least 915 mm behind the rearmost pedal face (seat back, pedals forward)
95th percentile helmet at least 50 mm below the line from the Main Hoop top to the Front Hoop top
With rearward bracing: helmet at least 50 mm from the line from the Main Hoop top to the bracing's lower end
With forward bracing: helmet no further back than the Main Hoop
Front Hoop top no lower than the top of the steering wheel at any angle
Front Hoop no more than 250 mm ahead of the steering wheel rim (horizontal, on the centerline, straight ahead)
Main Hoop Braces attached 160 mm or less below the Main Hoop's top-most surface
Top half of each tire unobstructed seen from above; wheels unobstructed seen from the side
Lowest point of the Lower Side Impact Structure 90 mm or less above the ground (75 mm or less recommended), with an opening to measure it
Every suspension mounting point visible at inspection (covers removable)
Critical fasteners: hex or socket head, not countersunk, with a positive locking mechanism (nyloc only below 80 °C) and two full threads past a lock nut
Steering free play under 7° total at the steering wheel
Steering rack mechanically attached to the chassis
Moving suspension and steering parts in the cockpit (from the Front Hoop to 100 mm behind the pedals) covered by a solid shield
Suspension mounts not on the span of the Main Hoop or its braces away from the nodes
Template head circle within 25 mm of the head restraint; all the team's drivers also clear the hoop lines by 50 mm
